I. GENERAL
Violence against women still occurs in society today. Various forms of such violence include rape, sexual harassment, human trafficking, domestic violence, sexual exploitation, violence against domestic workers, pornography, bullying, cyber bullying, and cyber porn.
This situation requires serious handling because it relates to the quality of human beings and the future of the Indonesian Nation. Law Number 7 of 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, and Law Number 21 of 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Criminal Act of Human Trafficking, impose obligations on the Government and the City Regional Government to provide protection for women. The provision of protection for women, according to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government and its amendments, includes prevention, referral services for women victims of violence, strengthening and development of women's protection service institutions.
Services for women victims of violence include complaint services, referrals, health rehabilitation, legal assistance and protection, social rehabilitation, return and social reintegration, and encouraging community participation in prevention and recovery efforts. Based on Article 12 paragraph (2) of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government and its amendments, the Sub-affair of women's protection is a mandatory non-basic service affair. Based on Article 217, Regional Apparatus that handles the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection is implemented by the Service (Dinas).
